title: The Cavern Creeper
summary: Defeat the Cavern Creeper after Leklos falls to continue the raid.
overview: Defeat the Cavern Creeper after Leklos falls to continue the raid.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Follow the chanting deeper into the cavern after defeating Leklos.
Tank the Cavern Creeper while the evokers perform their ritual.
Continue steady damage through the ritual announcements at 85%, 75% and 60%.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
The health-stage handlers only emit dialogue and explicitly question whether additional effects are missing. No weakening, shield or timed vulnerability effect is claimed.
